configuration.runStartupTasks.descriptio: Run startup tasks on activation (init script "Hello World" + environment detection). Turn off to trigger manually from the Environment view.
configuration.serialConsoleEnabled.descr: Enable serial server management and the command console (server entries / command sending / live output).
configuration.taskApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the task-management REST API (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /tasks). Leave empty to use the built-in stub simulation.

configuration.taskGroupWithSeparator.des: Group workspace tasks into virtual folders by splitting task labels on the separator.
configuration.taskGroupSeparator.descrip: Separator used to split task labels into tree folders (default "-"; multi-character separators such as "--" are supported).
configuration.taskGroupMaxLevel.descript: Maximum number of grouping levels split from task labels (1-15, default 5; each separator adds one level).
configuration.taskGroupMaxLevel.1: 1 level (e.g. a-b-c groups under folder a, leaf shows b-c)
configuration.taskGroupMaxLevel.2: 2 levels (e.g. a-b-c becomes a → b → leaf c)
configuration.taskGroupMaxLevel.5: 5 levels (default; a-b-c-d-e-f becomes a→b→c→d→e with leaf f)
configuration.taskGroupStripTaskLabel.de: Strip the group prefix from leaf task labels (full name stays in the tooltip).
configuration.taskNumLastTasks.descripti: How many recently run tasks to display in the "Recent" group (storage keeps up to 20).
configuration.taskExpanded.description: Default expanded state of the special groups (recent / favorites). Manual toggling is remembered by VS Code.
